hub.title: Scenic Journeys from Tokyo to Kyoto, Osaka & Hiroshima
hub.description: What you can see from the Shinkansen between Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and Hiroshima, scenic detours worth a day, and the Miyajima ferry to the Great Torii, with how to ride and book each one.
hub.h1: Scenic journeys from Tokyo to Kyoto, Osaka & Hiroshima
hub.sub: See Mt. Fuji from your Shinkansen, then choose a scenic detour or a ferry ride near Hiroshima.
hub.verified: Checked against official operator pages on 21 November 2026. Timetables change, so check the linked official page before you travel.

sections.title: Views from my train
sections.sub: No extra travel: the view is on the Shinkansen you are already taking.

items.name: Mt. Fuji from the Tokaido Shinkansen
items.imageAlt: Mt. Fuji seen from the Tokaido Shinkansen near Shin-Fuji
facts: Mt. Fuji, clearest around Shin-Fuji station, on clear days.
Tokyo → Kyoto or Shin-Osaka, any Nozomi, Hikari or Kodama.
Right side going to Kyoto and Osaka: Seat E in standard cars, Seat D in the Green Car. Left side on the way back.
A reserved seat on the Tokaido Shinkansen. Ask for Seat E at a JR ticket office, or add a window or Fuji-side preference on Klook (not a guaranteed Seat E).

items.name: Shin-Osaka to Hiroshima on the Sanyo Shinkansen
facts: We have not verified a headline view on this stretch, so we do not recommend a side. Book the seat that suits you.
Shin-Osaka → Hiroshima, about 1 h 25 min on some Mizuho services or about 1 h 50 min on some Hikari services.
A reserved seat Shin-Osaka → Hiroshima. Through tickets from Tokyo to Hiroshima are also sold.

sections.title: Scenic detours along the way
sections.sub: Worth a day or half a day off the Shinkansen. Each needs its own train and ticket.

items.name: Shonan coast on the Enoden
items.imageAlt: An Enoden train by the Shonan sea with Mt. Fuji
facts: The sea between Koshigoe and Inamuragasaki.
Fujisawa ↔ Kamakura, a day trip from Tokyo.
Yes: Tokyo to Fujisawa or Kamakura by JR, then the Enoden.

items.name: Hakone Tozan Railway
facts: The Hayakawa valley and three switchbacks.
Hakone-Yumoto to Gora; the switchbacks are between Deyama and Gora. A day trip or overnight from Tokyo.
Yes: Tokyo to Odawara or Hakone-Yumoto first.

items.name: Hozu gorge on the Sagano Romantic Train
items.imageAlt: The Hozu river and Hozukyo station from the Sagano Scenic Railway
facts: Torokko Saga ↔ Torokko Kameoka, west Kyoto; the gorge is between Torokko Arashiyama and Torokko Kameoka.
Yes: from Kyoto station to Saga-Arashiyama by JR.

items.name: etSETOra on the Kure Line (from Hiroshima)
items.imageAlt: The etSETOra sightseeing train at a station platform
facts: JR West's sightseeing train between Hiroshima and Fukuyama via the Kure Line, the coastal line east of Hiroshima.
Hiroshima 9:32 → Fukuyama 12:53 via Kure, Takehara, Mihara and Onomichi. The 14:17 return from Fukuyama arrives in Hiroshima at 17:22 on weekdays or 17:25 on weekends and public holidays.
Mondays, Fridays, weekends and public holidays, except the New Year period. Check JR West’s calendar for your date.
All seats are reserved. You need a fare ticket plus a reserved Green ticket for ordinary trains, bought before boarding.
Reserve through JR West’s e5489, at a major JR ticket office or through a travel agency. To pre-order sweets, book separately through tabiwa by WESTER at least four days before the ride.
Not stated by JR West, so we do not recommend a side.
Yes: a half-day ride from Hiroshima. Get off at Onomichi for the city. Its Shinkansen station, Shin-Onomichi, is separate. For a Shinkansen transfer at the same station, stay on etSETOra to Fukuyama.

items.name: The Great Torii from the Miyajima JR Ferry
items.imageAlt: Itsukushima island, Mt. Misen, the Great Torii and Miyajima ferries
facts: The Great Torii of Itsukushima Shrine from the sea.
JR Sanyo Line from Hiroshima to Miyajimaguchi, about 28 minutes.
Right side, facing forward, on Great Torii sailings.

tickets.title: Book the Shinkansen legs
tickets.sub: Stopping in Kyoto or Osaka? Book the legs you need separately. Take a direct Tokyo → Hiroshima train if you’re going straight through.
tickets.disclosure: We may earn a commission if you book through these links, at no extra cost to you.
tickets.boardingNote: Reserve an etSETOra seat before boarding. On the JR Miyajima Ferry, foot passengers can buy a ticket at the pier or tap a supported IC card.

notCovered: Not covered yet: the Marine Liner across the Seto-Ohashi Bridge (Okayama ↔ Takamatsu) is a detour off this route, and we have not checked its details with JR Shikoku yet.

ferry.title: Miyajima JR Ferry: Which Side for the Great Torii?
ferry.description: Take a Great Torii sailing of the JR ferry from Miyajimaguchi and look out on the right side. Sailing times, tide changes, fares and how to get there from Hiroshima.
ferry.h1: Which side of the Miyajima ferry for the Great Torii?
ferry.answerTitle: Right side, on a Great Torii sailing
ferry.answer: Take a Great Torii sailing from Miyajimaguchi. Face the direction the ferry is moving and look to your right as it passes the gate.
ferry.imageAlt: The Great Torii of Itsukushima Shrine seen from the JR ferry
facts: Great Torii sailings normally leave Miyajimaguchi from 9:10 to 16:10. Check the calendar for your travel date.
Tides and storm surges can change the route. Check the operator’s same-day status and notices before leaving for the pier.
About 10 minutes on either route. Daytime departures are usually 15 minutes apart on the regular timetable and 10 minutes apart on the busier timetable.
The one-way fare is ¥200 for adults and ¥100 for children aged 6 to 11. The ¥100 Miyajima Visitor Tax applies when entering the island. Preschool children are exempt from the tax.
The Japan Rail Pass covers the JR ferry fare. Pay the Miyajima Visitor Tax separately if it applies to you. Check the coverage of your specific JR-WEST regional pass.
You can tap Suica, ICOCA, PASMO or another supported transit IC card at the gate.
gettingThere: JR Sanyo Line from Hiroshima toward Iwakuni to Miyajimaguchi, about 28 minutes.
From the JR ticket gates, follow the underground passage to the ferry terminal.
Arriving by Shinkansen from Osaka or Tokyo? Get off at Hiroshima and change to the Sanyo Line.
If you’re traveling on foot, buy a ticket at the JR Miyajima Ferry counter or ticket machine, or go straight to the gate with a supported IC card.
tips: Great Torii sailings are departures from Miyajimaguchi, so plan to see the torii on the way out.
The torii looks different at high and low tide. Check the day's tide times if that matters to you.
Another operator runs ferries on the same crossing; this page covers JR's Great Torii sailings only.
